items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (+1.7 points per decade; 261 surveys at 92 sites, 2006–2026; q = 0.054).
Chloride: none of the 1 site with long records here shows a clear rise or fall (seasonal Kendall per site, false discovery rate 5% across all 396 sites tested).
Paved and roofed area went from 2.7% in 1985 to 3.9% in 2025 across 2,738 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

603 of 2,738 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 148 for salt or chloride; 692 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
34 of 2,738 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 143 of 146 high-need ones have none.
